message.content:
你是一个 Coder 子代理。修复附录来源全部显示"未知来源"的问题。

## 根因
`D:\1\daily-ai-insight-engine\src\synthesize\report-builder.ts` 的 `buildReferencesIndex` 方法（约第 337-346 行）硬编码了空字符串：
```typescript
return stats.top_by_significance.map((item) => ({
  id: item.id, title: item.title,
  source_name: '',   // ← bug
  source_url: '',    // ← bug
}));
```
`top_by_significance` 来自 `AggregationStats`，只含 `{id, title, score, published_at}`，没有 source 信息。

## 修复

### 1. `src/synthesize/report-builder.ts`

**`buildReport` 方法** — 新增最后一个参数 `items: StructuredInsightItem[]`，传给 `buildReferencesIndex`:
```typescript
buildReport(
  date: string,
  stats: AggregationStats,
  topEvents: TopEvent[],
  deepAnalyses: DeepAnalysis[],
  trends: TrendAnalysis,
  riskOpp: RiskOpportunityPanel,
  items: StructuredInsightItem[],  // 新增
): DailyReport {
  return {
    date,
    generated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    dashboard: { ... },
    top_events: topEvents,
    deep_analyses: deepAnalyses,
    trend_analysis: trends,
    risk_opportunity: riskOpp,
    references_index: this.buildReferencesIndex(items),  // 改传 items
  };
}
```

**`buildReferencesIndex` 方法** — 改为接收 `items: StructuredInsightItem[]`，从中提取真实 source:
```typescript
private buildReferencesIndex(
  items: StructuredInsightItem[],
): Array<{ id: string; title: string; source_name: string; source_url: string }> {
  return items.map((item) => ({
    id: item.id,
    title: item.title,
    source_name: item.source.name,
    source_url: item.source.url,
  }));
}
```

### 2. `src/pipeline/orchestrator.ts`

找到 `builder.buildReport(date, stats, topEvents, deepAnalyses, trends, riskOpp)` 调用，在末尾加上 `extractedItems`:
```typescript
report = builder.buildReport(date, stats, topEvents, deepAnalyses, trends, riskOpp, extractedItems);
```

### 3. `tests/synthesize/report-builder.test.ts`

所有 `builder.buildReport(...)` 调用末尾加上 items 参数（用已有的 sample items 或构造新的）。

## 验证
1. `npx tsc --noEmit` 零错误
2. `npm test` 全部通过
